column1:
Keep the good times flowing with new Smirnoff Freestyler RTDs, made with the refreshing taste of
Smirnoff, sparkling water and exploding with natural fruit flavours.
Fresh and original, new Smirnoff Freestylers are made for the free spirits amongst us – prepared to
go wherever the good vibes are at! Full of natural flavours but with none of the sugar, add a little bit
of extra style to those sunny afternoons with mates.
4.5% with no added sugar.
Available in:
• Mango and Passionfruit
• Orange and Lemon
• 300ml RGB
• 330ml Slim Can
